description: Read the publish settings of one of the user's own R3 projects in this environment — what the app's Deploy → Settings shows: Works on (keyboard / touch / both / not tested), the SEO title and description that search engines and link previews show, how the live page starts (Start button, first click, on load), its controls and badge, and what Save does for a live project. Also answers a SUGGESTION for Works on, from a scan of the project's code for keyboard / touch / pointer handlers — only a suggestion. r3_publish_settings_set changes them. Needs the project:read right.
name: r3_publish_settings_read

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Read a project's publish settings
